text: The figure shows two plots comparing voxel sizes of lesions in different datasets: a histogram for 655 subjects, an orange bar for 524 subjects, and another blue bar for 112 subjects; and a box plot for axial plane lesion pixel sizes from the 524-case set. The histograms indicate that the distribution of lesion voxel sizes varies across these groups, with different ranges and densities. The box plots show the median (line inside the box), quartiles (bottom and top edges of the box), and whiskers (extending to the furthest data points within 1.5 times the interquartile range).
summary: The figure compares lesion voxel sizes across different datasets, showing variations in distribution density and ranges.

visible_text: Fig. 6. Lesion distributions in ATLAS v2.0.
(a) Lesion voxel-size distribution for the 524 cases used to train/evaluate 2D models and the 112 cases reserved for aggregation and 3D segmentation.
(b) Axialplane lesion pixel-size distribution for the 524-case set and for one representative cross-validation fold.
key_observations: Histograms showing voxel size distributions across different datasets.
Box plots comparing axial plane lesion pixel sizes from two sets of data.
